description: This file defines the class Zend_Http_UserAgent_Features_Adapter_DeviceAtlas, which implements a features adapter using the DeviceAtlas API to extract device features from HTTP request data within the Zend Framework.

classes.name: Zend_Http_UserAgent_Features_Adapter_DeviceAtlas
classes.description: Implements a device features adapter leveraging DeviceAtlas API to extract device data from HTTP headers.

methods.name: getFromRequest
methods.description: Extracts device features from the request array using the DeviceAtlas API, relying on configuration parameters and handling missing dependencies with exceptions.
